basis: Existing accepted bank-first exploratory plus conditionalprefix scope; explicit conditional execution authorization, not observation-only. Root owns all operations.
pre_unhold: Fresh exact CPU RUNNING/READY/config and immutable GPU bindings; immediately verify current_UTC+180 < cutoff. Arm only exact accepted watcher/helper.
rules: Same unstarted GPU job and immutable charge/config only; no cancellation, new GPU attempt, extension or refund.
Use UTC epochs for scheduler timestamps and monotonic elapsed bound; individually bound remote commands so operation plus hold confirmation fits safety margin.

Pending forecast greater than cutoff means prompt rehold. Plain Unknown forecast may be polled only inside the120-second operation; unknown at deadline means rehold. Pending at deadline is reheld even if forecast was earlier.
RUNNING success requires actual original job/resource facts and actualStartTime no later than cutoff and currentUTC. Existing per-phase helper gates remain necessary.

After rehold attempt positively reread state. If RUNNING beforecutoff, treat as this one authorized attempt; never cancel/retry. If hold state/timing/identity cannot be established, stop automatic phase publication and preserve/escalate uncertainty.
On confirmed still-unstarted JobHeldUser, stop watcher and confirm no phase/release/helper execution. Preserve observations and original charge.
unchanged_gates: same replacement CPU for both proofs
limitation: No assertion that forecast or this ruling guarantees completion of bank and prefix. No actual unhold or phase action performed by reviewer.
